Claude Code reports that roughly ninety percent of the code it ships is both written and reviewed by Claude itself, turning the model into a self‑auditing partner.

The team’s verification loop uses three test families—end‑to‑end, property‑based, and differential—allowing dozens of agents to run in parallel without human bottlenecks.

A separate rubric‑driven grader lifted structured‑file‑generation success by as much as ten points on the most challenging problems, showing the power of cheap, automated evidence.

“End‑to‑end tests give a clear pass or fail and visual proof of failures.”  

Embedding automated verification into LLM pipelines reduces manual review time and improves code reliability at scale.

The data reflects internal benchmarks focused on structured‑file generation; results may vary for other domains.
